description: This file defines data models and methods related to channel members in Mattermost, including structures for unread messages, member info, validation, and notification properties.

classes.name: ChannelUnread
classes.description: Represents unread message counts and mention counts for a channel.

classes.name: ChannelUnreadAt
classes.description: Tracks unread message counts, mention counts, and last viewed timestamp for a user in a channel.

classes.name: ChannelMember
classes.description: Contains information about a user's membership in a channel, including roles, notification preferences, and timestamps.

classes.name: ChannelMemberWithTeamData
classes.description: Extends ChannelMember with additional team display information.

classes.name: ChannelMemberForExport
classes.description: Channel member data formatted for export, including channel name and username.

classes.name: ChannelMemberIdentifier
classes.description: Unique identifier for a channel member, combining channel ID and user ID.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the channel member's data for auditing purposes.

methods.name: SanitizeForCurrentUser
methods.description: Sanitizes sensitive timestamp fields if the member is not the current user.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the channel member's IDs and notification properties.

methods.name: IsChannelMemberNotifyPropsValid
methods.description: Validates the notification properties map for a channel member.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Updates the LastUpdateAt timestamp before saving.

methods.name: PreUpdate
methods.description: Updates the LastUpdateAt timestamp before updating.

methods.name: GetRoles
methods.description: Returns the roles of the member as a slice of strings.

methods.name: SetChannelMuted
methods.description: Sets the mute state of the channel for the member.

methods.name: IsChannelMuted
methods.description: Checks if the channel is muted for the member.
